title: Conditonal Lipschitz stability for the Inverse Problem of the 2D Navier-Stokes System in a Bounded Domain
summary: This paper concerns an inverse problem for the initial boundary value problem of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes system defined in a bounded simply connected domain with slip, vorticity boundary conditions, and a global vorticity invariant constraint. We establish conditional Lipschitz stability and a local recovery for this inverse problem, where the velocity field and space-independent boundary vorticity are locally recovered from the given initial velocity field and the global vorticity invariant.
